messages.subject: Machine Learning Algorithms for species occupancy
parts:
Dear list members,

I apologize if my question is out of topic.

Is there any attempt to apply "newer" machine learning algorithms, like random forests or neural network (to mention a few not using maximum likelihood estimation), for species occupancy, taking into account detection probability?

Manuel

messages.subject: Re: Machine Learning Algorithms for species occupancy
parts:
Hi Manuel!

There is this paper using neural networks to investigate non-linear relationships for the context of occupancy models:
Joseph, M. B. (2020). Neural hierarchical models of ecological populations. Ecology Letters, 23(4), 734-747.

Cheers, 
Ismael
